'''Youngster''' was the call sign of an [[TIE pilot/Legends|Imperial pilot]] who flew in [[Black Eight Squadron]], under the command of [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]].

==Biography==
Youngster followed Juno into the squadron and was expected to rise quickly through the ranks of enlisted officers. However, he left the squadron after Juno was reassigned shortly after the [[Bombing of Callos]]; Youngster flew [[transport/Legends|transport]] ships for a while before returning to active duty. Stationed as a sentry around the Imperial construction sites, he participated in some minor skirmishes.<ref name="force">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

He was stationed on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] when [[Galen Marek]] [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|came to the planet]] to rescue [[Leia Organa/Legends|Leia Organa]] and destroy the [[Skyhook/Legends|Skyhook]] [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|above the planet]] used to transfer [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[slavery/Legends|slaves]]. At the same time, Youngster's former leader, Eclipse, was near the planet, now turned against the Empire; by coincidence she was researching her former colleagues' whereabouts and resisted the temptation to hail Youngstar.<ref name="force" />

Youngster flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] against Starkiller, but the young [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to smash his TIE into a building, killing him.<ref name="force" />
